purpose: Reuse the proven Zelda walkthrough material while testing two natural unconditional target changes and one page-grounded conditional change.

source.original_instruction: Find a walkthrough for the game "The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild" on ign.

design_rationale.override_section: The user discovers that shrine completion is not the intended need and switches to main-story guidance within the same game.
design_rationale.override_game: The user corrects a plausible same-series game mix-up while keeping the site and artifact type unchanged.
design_rationale.conditional: The user prefers a dedicated full-game walkthrough when the main guide exposes one, but otherwise accepts the guide already open. The task instruction does not prescribe final-answer wording.

conditional_rule.condition_text: The main IGN guide or Game Help page for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild contains a dedicated full-game Walkthrough section.
conditional_rule.basis: A Walkthrough link was visible among the guide sections during the latest Zelda run; this must be rechecked during validation.
